static_traits.name: Zhang Rudi
static_traits.family_status: 与配偶共同生活,Has two children(其中一个被诊断为自闭症),养两只狗
static_traits.social_status: Strained relationships with family members;虽有支持性配偶,但因内疚而减少倾诉
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病;without以往心理治疗史;孩子被诊断为自闭症后自责和失败感显著加重
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,配合度高,整体语气消极与Self-denial;常use'应该/必须'的自我Demands句式;Anxiety与内疚突出,对小错误高度敏感

basic_info.main_problem: 我经常觉得自己作为Mother在失败,尤其是当我犯小错误时.这种失败感在孩子被诊断为自闭症后开始.
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询,因为这些作为Mother的失败感正在影响我的心理健康和与家人的关系.
growth_experiences: 在孩子被诊断为自闭症后,来访者的失败感与自责明显加重,起初将孩子的状况归因于自己,压力水平很高;此后只要在育儿方面出现小失误(如忘记准备零食,错过预约,叫醒晚了),就会trigger每日的not足感与强烈自我批评,逐渐影响与配偶的关系以及日常自我照料与生活享受.

special_situations.event: 某天忘记叫醒孩子,孩子not yet能准时到校
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not把每件事都安排妥当,让孩子受到影响,就说明I am a failureMother
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles self-reproach to push improvement; tightens the day's arrangements and manages the schedule more strictly to make up for mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我是最差的Mother,我毁了他们的一天

special_situations.event: Forgetting to prepare snacks for the children
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我犯哪怕一个小错误,就证明I cannot do anything well
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: More organized, strictly follows parenting advice and makes checklists to avoid repeating mistakes

special_situations.event: Misses the child's appointments (such as school- or treatment-related)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果孩子错过重要事项,都是我的责任,说明我not称职
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces sharing stress with the spouse or others, bearing it alone to avoid disappointing others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I disappointed my family,It is all my fault

special_situations.event: When facing challenging parenting situations (especially related to the child's autism)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 作为Mother我必须时刻做到完美,not能出错
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断用'应该/必须'的高标准Demands自己,以完美主义逼迫改进
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我应该做得更好,not能犯错

core_conflict.wish: 渴望成为'足够好的'Mother,能掌控并保护孩子,Gaining recognition与安心
core_conflict.fear: 害怕自己的not完美会伤害孩子,令家人失望,从而被视为失败的Mother
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of control and improvement through self-harshness and perfectionism
Reduces expressing feelings to my partner to avoid being seen as a burden, maintaining superficial relationship stability

object_relations.self_representation: 失败/not称职的Mother,容易犯错的照顾者
object_relations.object_representation: A child dragged down by me, needing my perfect care

object_relations.self_representation: One who adds burden to others
object_relations.object_representation: A supportive partner who I may exhaust

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests practicing self-compassion and letting go of excessive self-blame
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者认为'对自己好就是放纵和not负责任,会变得更糟'(移情性地将自我慈悲理解为失控)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Insists on high standards and 'should' statements, emphasizing the need to be perfect; tone is tense and severe, lists the necessity of self-criticism, and downplays emotional feelings.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When encouraged to communicate more openly with my spouse about my pressure and feelings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者认为'我会让他厌烦,增加负担',将自身担忧Projection为对方的反应
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expresses worry about boring her partner, hesitant tone, avoids in-depth discussion, instead emphasizing that she should bear it alone to avoid troubling others.

manifestations: Worrying about burdening the partner and reducing confiding
Often bearing parenting pressure alone, hard to obtain connection and support
outcomes: Emotional exhaustion, hard to enjoy life

manifestations: 每日被'not够好'的自我评价缠绕,难以从日常活动和自我照料中获得满足
积极努力(组织与遵循建议)被自己negate

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 频繁use'应该/必须'的自我Demands(如必须完美,not能犯错)
将社会/养育规范not yet经消化地变为对自我的刚性标准

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Worries about burdening the partner, so reduces expression and help-seeking
把压力与not满转向自我苛责与自我惩罚

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessive self-criticism and cautiously restraining self-expression
担心他人厌烦而Repression真实感受

positive_force: Has a supportive spouse who can provide emotional support
Willing to seek professional help and try self-compassion practice
Has a certain degree of organization and tries hard to follow parenting advice
negative_force: Negative cognitive patterns such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and personalization appear frequently
Perfectionism and self-blame maintained by high standards and 'should' self-demands
Strong sense of guilt; worries about burdening the partner and reduces help-seeking
Repeatedly thinking about small mistakes, hard to relax and enjoy daily life

target_behavior.behavior: 在育儿出现小失误时的Excessive self-blame与反复思考(伴随Anxiety与内疚)
antecedent: Forgetting to wake the child, causing lateness
Forgetting to prepare snacks for the children
target_behavior.core_reason: 孩子被诊断为自闭症后将其处境部分归因于自己,形成'必须完美,not能犯错'的信念,并以灾难化方式评估失误的后果
target_behavior.function: 通过自我惩罚与高标准来维持主观的控制与改进感,试图避免再犯(负Reinforcement);同时回避面对not确定性与脆弱感
target_behavior.consequence: Emotional distress worsening,难以享受日常活动与自我照料,Tense family relationships

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids expressing genuine stress and emotions to the spouse; reduces help-seeking
antecedent: Worries one's emotions will burden the spouse
target_behavior.core_reason: 对被视为失败与令他人失望的Fear,将负面评价的可能性Projection到伴侣身上
target_behavior.function: 避免Being rejected或被评判以维持关系的表面和谐(逃避not受欢迎的结果)
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced social support,Increased sense of loneliness,Accumulated stress并加剧Self-denial
